Key Points
Business Overview
[1]
Damodar Industries is engaged in the manufacture of cotton, melange, speciality, slub, multiblend and value-added yarns for domestic and international markets. The Company focuses on product quality, operational efficiency and innovation, supported by a diversified product portfolio, in-house R&D capabilities and investments in modern spinning technologies to cater to the evolving requirements of the textile industry.
